msContents.summary: [p]Collection of alchemical and other tracts and extracts, with a few medical and household receipts: mainly in Latin, but with a few entries in French. Illustrated with a few roughly drawn alchemical signs and sigils. Contents: (Inside upper cover) Retour de Paris à Bourdeux. Leaf A Chemin de Bourdeaux à Paris. Tables of stages. Av Medicinal weights (in french). B. Reciepts for Hippocras (in French). [p]Contains the following works: [li](Anon.) Proba d'un Reverendo Padre donaata l'anno 1617, pp. 43-55.[/li][li]Mazzotta (Benedictus). De mineralibus, rebusque subterraneis aliisque arcanis chymicis, pp. 57-119.[/li][li]Bernhardus Trevisanus. Practica de lapide. Enigma. In Italian, pp. 120-126.[/li][li](Anon.) Trattato d'alcuni medicamenti spargirici (sic) e loro virtu e pre-parazione, pp. 127-183.[/li][li]Hoghelande (Theobald von). Secreta revelatio verae operationis manualis tam pro universali opere et lapide sapientum quam pro particularibus quibusdam, pp. 185-243.[/li][li](Anon.) In librum de potestate angelica. ad 206: Articulum sextum. An aurum fieri possit saltem a magis virtute Cacodaemonum?, pp. 245-290.[/li][li](Anon.) Trattato d'erbe secondo l'influssi de' pianeti, pp. 291-302.[/li][li]Abbatia (Antonius de). Ad mentem Reverendi Antonii Arcipresbytri de Abbatia (de lapide philosophico), pp. 303-306.[/li][li]Lullius (Raymundus). Ordo mineralium secundum Raymundum, pp. 306-314.[/li][li]Christophorus Parisiensis. Extract from 'Alfabeto', pp. 314-315.[/li][li]M. (C. A.). Ex C. A. M. (Alchemical process.), pp. 316-319.[/li][li]Lullius (Raymundus). Elucidatio Testamenti, pp. 319-329.[/li][li]Miscellanea Alchemica III, 1 volume[/li][li]Instruction à l'Arithmétique, pp. 1-28.[/li][li]Pseudo-Thomas Aquinas, St. Tractatus de lapide philosophico, pp. 29-42.[/li][li]Pseudo-Thomas Aquinas, St. Tractatus datus Fratri Reinaldo in arte alchimica, pp. 42-49.[/li][li]Rupescissa (J. de). Liber Lucis, pp. 49-60[/li][li]Lullius (R.). Clavicula, pp. 61-73.[/li][li]Index, p.74[/li][li]De la matière des Armes et de quoy sont faictes, pp. 75-79.[/li][li]Index, p. 79.[/li][li]Alchemical receipts in Latin, pp. 80-86.[/li][li]Theoria de lapide philosophorum, pp. 87-104.[/li][li]Theoria et praxis de lapide philosophorum (etc.), pp. 105-109, 200-232.[/li][li]Khunrath (H.).
